'''Corpse spiders''' are arachnids found in the second room of the [[Lumbridge Catacombs]], which can only be entered after completing [[The Blood Pact]] quest. They were created by [[Dragith Nurn]], a now undead necromancer, during his experiments with stolen corpses and local animals. Because they used to be humans, they have a human face on their back. It is the only spider to drop bones, likely due to their human components.

They drop the [[mask part 2]], which can be used with the 4 other parts to create the [[Mask of Dragith Nurn]].

Corpse spiders are often killed for [[invention]] [[materials]] using the [[scavenging]] perk due to the ability to kill many of them in a short period of time.
